count.description: Number of endpoints in results, after the limit cut.

endpoint_id.description: Dotted identifier to pass to comfyui_get or comfyui_execute, e.g. "history.get".

method.description: HTTP method the endpoint is invoked with.

path.description: Request path template; {name} segments are filled from the params object.

summary.description: What the endpoint returns and the traps it carries.

score.description: Keyword match score; higher sorts first.
